description: Fuzzy file finder over the workspace, ranked the way an editor's open-file palette ranks. Candidates come from git when the root is a repository and from the folder listing when it is not.

include_untracked.description: Include files git does not track yet (still honouring `.gitignore`). On by default — a file the agent just created is exactly the one you are looking for. Ignored outside a repository, where the workspace listing is the source of candidates.

limit.description: Rows to return. Defaults to the worker's `find_limit`.

query.description: Fuzzy query. Matched as a subsequence against every tracked path, with basename and word-boundary hits ranked highest. Empty returns the first `limit` paths unranked.

positions.description: Byte offsets into `path` that matched, in order — enough to highlight the match without re-running the matcher in the UI.

score.description: Higher is better. Comparable only within one response.

from_git.description: True when candidates came from git's listing (so `.gitignore` was honoured), false when they came from the folder walk.

scanned.description: Paths considered. Compare against `truncated` to know whether the whole repo was ranked.

truncated.description: True when the workspace held more paths than `max_find_candidates` and only the first of them were ranked.
